name: widgetctl
description: Set up iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets with the local widgetctl CLI and API.

interface.longDescription: Add, find, edit and remove individual iOS Simulator Home Screen widgets with the local widgetctl CLI, TypeScript API or Playwright fixture. Requires macOS, Node 22.14+, full Xcode and a separately installed widgetctl npm package. Supports verified arm64 iPhone simulator runtimes; physical devices, stacks and Lock Screen widgets are unsupported.
